title: Generation and immunofluorescent validation of gene knockouts in adult human colonic organoids using multi-guide RNA CRISPR-Cas9
protocol: Warm EDTA harvesting solution to 37°C.
Ensure a water bath has equilibrated to 37°C.
Place the surgical tissue in cold FBS/PBS solution to minimize warm ischemia time.
Transport the specimen to the laboratory in an ice box.
Wash the specimen in 25 mL of FBS/PBS in a 50 mL centrifuge tube and gently agitate the solution.
Repeat the washing step twice using fresh FBS/PBS.
Transfer the specimen into 25 mL of EDTA harvesting solution in a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Submerge the entire centrifuge tube in a water bath.
Shake the tube on a vortex or by hand beginning at 0 min, repeating every 2 min for a total of 10 min.
Transfer the specimen into a new 50 mL centrifuge tube containing 25 mL of EDTA harvesting solution.
Add 25 mL of FBS/PBS to the previous EDTA harvesting solution containing crypts and store in an ice box.
Repeat shaking of the new EDTA harvesting solution as per steps 5a and 5b.
Remove the specimen and discard.
Add 25 mL of FBS/PBS to the second EDTA harvesting solution with crypts.
Centrifuge both EDTA harvesting solutions at 400 g × 6 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant from both tubes.
Resuspend pellets in 5 mL of FBS/PBS.
Pipette two 10 μL aliquots of the suspension to a cell culture dish and observe under the microscope.
Count the number of crypts in each aliquot and take average.
This gives the concentration of crypts in the crypt suspension.
Multiply this by 500 to obtain the total number of crypts in the crypt pellet.
Transfer the total volume of crypt suspension to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Top up the centrifuge tube to 5 mL with FBS/PBS.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 6 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuge tube.
Add BME based on the calculated crypt-to-BME ratio.
Resuspend the crypts in BME, avoiding air bubbles.
Place the suspension in a 37°C incubator for 30 minutes to allow BME to solidify.
Add penicillin/streptomycin and Y27632 to human conditioned media.
If using a 24-well plate, add 500 μL of supplemented human conditioned media to each well.
Return the plate to the incubator.
Change the media every 2-3 days or earlier if signs of acidification are observed.
Place a 24-well plate in a 37°C incubator.
Add 500 μl of Organoid Harvesting Solution to each well and place the plate on ice for at least 45 min.
Using a P1000 pipette, aspirate the organoid harvesting solution while breaking down any remnant BME and transfer to a 15 mL centrifugation tube.
Centrifuge at 400 g × 6 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate the supernatant, leaving the cell pellet undisturbed, and resuspend in Advanced DMEM+++.
Use a P200 pipette to triturate the resuspension 100 times.
Add advanced DMEM+++ to reach a total volume of 5 mL.
Centrifuge at 400 g × 6 min at 4°C again.
Gently aspirate the supernatant, leaving the cell pellet undisturbed, and add BME based on previous passage expansion ratio.
Plate organoids resuspended in BME into domes in each well of a 24-well plate.
Return the plate to the incubator.
Set up 25 mL of Advanced DMEM++ with 25 μL of Y27632 added.
Prepare a 15 mL centrifuge tube with 10 μL of Y27632 added.
Prepare a 1.5 mL microtube with 750 μL of solution from step 30a.
Remove media from wells.
Add 500 μL of TrypLe to each well, breaking down the BME dome, and transferring the suspension to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Submerge the centrifuge tube in a 37°C water bath for 10 min in total.
Triturate the organoid suspension with a P1000 pipette 10 times at 5 min.
Repeat trituration at 7.5 min.
Centrifuge at 400 g × 6 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend in 10 μL/reaction of Buffer T.
Optimize the molar ratios of Cas9 and multi-guide RNA to achieve a ratio of 1:4 for transfection efficacy.
Prepare the multi-guide RNA consisting of three different gRNAs targeting a region in proximity with each other.
Leave the Cas9 and multi-guide RNA complex at room temperature for 10 min.
Place 3 ml of Buffer E into the disposable Neon Tube.
Select optimized settings on the Neon device for adult human intestinal organoids.
Mix cell suspension with the RNP complex, ensuring equal volumes if measured correctly.
Aspirate 10 μl of the cell suspension mixture using the Neon pipette.
Place the aspirated suspension into the Neon Pipette Station and press “Start” to trigger electroporation.
Change the Neon pipette tip after 2 electroporation triggers.
Change the Neon Tube after 10 electroporation triggers.
Transfer cells to a 1.5 mL microtube immediately after electroporation.
Leave the cells at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 g for 6 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and add 40 μL/well of BME.
Plate the cells on a 24-well plate and incubate in a 37°C incubator for 30 minutes.
Add 500 μL of human IntestiCult to each well.
After 48 hours, change the media to human conditioned media.
Refresh the media every 2-3 days.
Prepare Organoid blocking solution fresh on ice.
Fix organoids by adding 500 μL of 2% (v/v) paraformaldehyde in 100 mM PBS to each well.
Incubate the cell culture at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Critical: Perform this step in a chemical fume hood as fixative chemicals are toxic and should not be performed in a biosafety cabinet.
Coat transfer pipettes with PBSB before use.
Remove fixative using a coated transfer pipette.
Gently add ice-cold DPBS to each well after removing fixative.
Transfer fixed organoids into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add ice-cold DPBS to the tube to reach a total volume of 10 mL.
Invert the tube gently without vortexing or centrifuging.
Allow organoids to settle under gravity on ice for about 10 minutes.
Remove the supernatant from the settled organoids.
Fill tubes with appropriate Organoid blocking solution.
Incubate organoids with gentle agitation for 3 hours at room temperature.
Prepare diluted mouse anti-FBXW7 antibody at a concentration of 1:100 in Organoid blocking solution.
Replace the supernatant with diluted FBXW7 antibody, protecting samples from light and keeping them at 4°C.
Incubate organoids with primary antibodies for 24 hours with gentle agitation.
Prepare Organoid washing solution as specified.
Allow organoids to settle under gravity for 10 minutes after incubation.
Remove the supernatant carefully.
Wash organoids by inverting the tube gently 10 times with Organoid washing solution.
Repeat steps of removing supernatant and washing organoids three more times.
Allow organoids to settle under gravity for 10 minutes.
Prepare diluted goat anti-mouse antibody at 1 μg/mL in Organoid washing solution.
Incubate organoids with secondary antibodies for 2 hours with gentle agitation.
Repeat steps 62–64.
Optional: Incubate organoids for 30–60 minutes in DPBS with fluorescent phalloidin diluted 1:400, at room temperature with gentle agitation and light protection.
Wash organoids twice with DPBS.
Optional: Prepare DAPI to working concentration of 300 nM in DPBS.
Incubate organoids in DAPI for 1–5 minutes at room temperature.
Wash organoids twice with DPBS.
